title: Gift filings that break the form's own rules or need a second look
question: Do any of the gift filings break the form's stated rules, or carry entries that look mistaken?
finding: 11 department-months carry more than one original filing although the form allows one (7 of them the same total filed twice); 2 replaced filings were signed before the month they report (mislabelled months); one filing names the signing department head as the donor; 10 replaced filings were true replacements whose gifts the later filing repeats.
how: Cover pages (export of 17 November 2026) are grouped by filing series; the signed PDFs give the month, signer and gifts.
limits: These are clerical questions for the departments and the Ethics Commission. Two originals for one month usually mean a second batch of gifts filed as an original instead of an amendment.
